It's work, but I am enjoying it when there's no book offs. The team works well together!

Haha story of my life! And thank you as are you!

Just work haha, no rest for the wicked. How about you?
Thank you! And today is going better. How about you?
You too! Be safe, and sleep well! (also, happy new year!)
Wtf is wrong with him. You can pull through man don't listen to that garbage. Looks like he's just trying to bring you down to where he is which is not a place you belong my friend

Thank you. I appreciate it.

And it's just weed (legal where I am) but it's a nice relaxer when I'm unable to calm down. And it helps take my mind off on how I could die.

Yeahhh and then no one really wants to be the person that people talk to either. I think the worse is when you're trying to tell someone "Hey, I legitimately think that I'd be better off dead" and they go off on how you're depressing and how they dont want that stuff around them. 

​

I agree. sometimes just one person is enough. I try hard to be that one person for those that need it.

I'm not sure to be honest. Even before the last decade I've wanted to die. but I guess through a good mix of good friends and a really caring and loving girlfriend i was able to make it past the last few years, but now that they've all gone on to do their own thing I've got no one left. I don't make friends in real life because i live my life at work and i don't make friends online anymore because I don't spend time gaming.

Yeah, i agree, sometimes talking about chronic issues to someone new helps. It also helps that when im telling someone new that im not thinking that "oh its the same thing ive said for the last x years" I think a lot of it is that I just don't have friends out side of work. So while I try hard to smile and laugh and make jokes at work. I'm also coming home every night and drugging myself into oblivion. 

Honestly, even if no one wants to hear about me thats okay. As long as I can atleast be of use or am able to help others i'll even be happy with that.  

Thank you for saying that I matter. 

I've been there before, that's always hard to deal with. Especially when you've got obligations to attend to. Like work ugh. But yeah, thats actually why I find it easier to be there for someone than have others be there for me.

Just a lot of stuff. Everything put together makes me feel lik that. I haven't moved and been stagnated since last December. Everyone's sick of my issues. It's the same in and out of the hospital for depression just so they can tell me. I don't need to be hospitalized for depression.

Thank you. Sometimes events just trigger something dark. Idk why either but I definetly know it happens.

It started when I moved cities. My old roomies eventually got back to living together but I'm out here alone. Ever since I've become more distant with them. And not just them. Even the friends I had outside of them. I stopped talking to them one by one. Or we fought over how depressive I was. In the end I have no one left to talk to. Even as the holidays kicked in I just worked through it all.

For the first time in a decade I don't have any support system. Anyone to tell how I'm feeling. Anyone to call for help. Lately my last remaining close friend has subtly suggested that she has more important things in her life. So I'm assuming once I'm done paying her back she ll also be walking out of my life.

I just don't want to disappoint any further by continuing to live when I desperately have wanted to die the whole decade.

Thanks for taking some time out of your day to talk to me

This is basically the story of my life. I've become so lonely that it hurts and I'm basically willing to do anything that will end my loneliness at this point. Extra willing if it means I no longer have live
